scope: Exact-unit manual application installation, boot identity and preserved-Gecko recovery engineering trial
authorization: Owner explicitly authorized testing the connected ZB-GW04; HA configuration and paired-device state were to be preserved
operator: Tech Lead/root, with the owner operating BOOT and RESET

manual_runtime.method: Reviewed manual runner in isolated action containers using the original image and exact selected device
manual_runtime.compatibility_limit: The 0.13-compatible daemon was stopped during the manual 0.14 trial. No normal-update compatibility or newer-version check was bypassed.

manual_runner_provenance.kind: Reviewed private staging snapshot, not the later unregistered source adapter
manual_runner_provenance.orchestration_revision_note: The operator reports an earlier revision performed the initial service stop; the final revision changed the Supervisor state check. The final hash is not asserted for every action in the window.

operator_reported_results.host_wide_device_ownership_check_before_: passed; no remaining target owners or denied process inspections reported

independently_verified_restoration.method: Comparisons and detailed receipts retained on HA; read-only authenticated native API GETs, no direct UART access
independently_verified_restoration.entity_difference: Only modified_at timestamps changed; the original strict failure and before/after evidence are retained privately

backup_boundary.limitation: Selective same-host app/radio rollback protection while HA storage remains intact; not a full HA or off-host disaster-recovery backup

software_source_checks.relationship_to_trial: Separate source-quality evidence. The unregistered adapter and its later helper cleanup change were not used by this manual trial.

limitations: Evidence applies to one exact ZB-GW04 1v2 and the selected application artifacts.
Application-only validation and observed Gecko operation do not establish full-flash or factory-state byte equality.
The starting application was project firmware, so entry from factory-stock firmware was not tested.
Normal service restoration is distinct from the disarmed manual trial and does not qualify RF control or an HA-driven firmware job.
Manual recovery after a completed transfer does not qualify interruption recovery.
The separate private 0.14-compatible candidate runtime and fake provisioning prototype were not deployed or exercised on this radio.
